name: basket
scene: twin / hardware 'Tidy up the table' basket steps (config_rl.yaml): one spec per object, instantiated with object = pill bottle | cup | tape roll | bottle. Same ladder as bottle_basket.

subtasks.criterion: gripper open and moving toward the {object}; no finger touches it; the {object} at its start spot
fingers closing on the {object}; it still rests on the table
the {object} held between both fingers and clear of the table, still near its start spot
the {object} held and travelling toward or hovering above the basket
the {object} over or inside the basket rim; fingers opening or just opened
gripper empty, the {object} resting inside the basket, arm moving away
arm not moving for the whole strip, or doing something none of the entries above describes

stages.name: reach
stages.criterion: finger midpoint within about 6 cm of the {object}

stages.name: held
stages.criterion: both fingers in contact with the {object}

stages.name: lifted
stages.criterion: held and the {object} more than 3 cm above where it rested

stages.name: over
stages.criterion: lifted and the {object} above the basket footprint

stages.name: inside
stages.criterion: the {object} inside the basket, below the rim, no finger touching it
